abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +2 to Wits, and -1 to either Iron or Edge (your choice).

Binary processing: The first three assets you purchase after character creation cost 2xp to purchase, but still cost 2xp to upgrade. And, once per session, when using your analytical mind to solve a problem through @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information}, @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.d9208f9b7d827aec]{React Under Fire}, or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash}, if you score a miss or a weak hit, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-1) to make it a strong hit.
